dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are... the Master of the Adventurers' Guild, right?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Haha, you got a good memory.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: It's just a title, nothing more.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I only became some legendary adventurer for completing some top-tier commissions by chance.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: The real legends... are for you to create! Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: My story? What is there to tell?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Let's see... I slew three dragons, crushed two international pirate organizations, saved Teyvat once... Nothing major.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: ...Where was I? I think I'm getting a bit too tipsy...
